**Notes on what I did not touch:**
- INV-10769 — already paid, no action taken
- INV-73032 — $8,941.78 still in **draft** ("Awaiting approval"); not approved, so I did not pay it
- Amount was under the $10,000 threshold, so no controller approval was required
